_about: Every measured case where colleges award DIFFERENT HOURS for the SAME named credit recommendation, restricted to rows that name a receiving college course AND were acted on (cpl_status_plan in 'Applied to CPL Plan','In Process'). Sam's ruling, 2026-09-07 (decision sheet item 2): the articulations toggle shows PRESENCE; the disagreement is a worklist, not a map layer.
_source: public.map_college_cr_unit (MAP's credit funnel, 206,702 rows) joined to public.map_colleges
_method: Group by (exhibit_id, normalized recommendation name); keep groups held by >1 college with >1 distinct leading hour value. ⚠ Counting distinct recommendation TEXT per exhibit (2,834) or hours per exhibit (678) both count an exhibit's own tiered MENU as a disagreement — ACE writes '3 / 6 / 9 hours in air traffic control' on one exhibit and a single college holds all three lines on one course in one catalog year. Presence in the funnel is not a decision; cpl_status_plan is.

cases.note: Two colleges, two courses, twice the credit. The clearest case of the four.
Glendale and Reedley each appear at both values, against different receiving courses.
Coastline carries two courses with the same title at different credit. Likely a duplicate course, not a judgment.
